about: check-size.mts --budgets: gzip bytes the browser downloads, per class, from dist/ after npm run build. JS is measured with Vite's 8-character chunk hashes replaced by a fixed string, so renaming a chunk does not move the totals. A size over its budget fails; a size more than 5% under fails until the budget is lowered, so budgets only go down. Reset 2026-11-05 at 3d24764 to the hash-stable measure plus 25 B (entry 33145, boot 1166495, workers 4725691, lazy 3051867). Then lazy raised from 3051892 to 3052205 (measured 3052195, +328 B over main), an exception the Captain approved for a player-facing fix in lazy code: the client re-traces a predicted hit past the server's rewind cap against the pose at the cap so it shows no marker the server will take back (ClientMatch.lateVerdict, #222).
